This indicates a possible chain of associations where Ciprofloxacin may indirectly influence the development of Necrotizing Ulcerative Gingivitis via its interaction with Azithromycin. However, the evidence is indirect and does not establish a direct causal relationship. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as it relies on indirect indications rather than direct clinical or pharmacological evidence. Further research would be needed to determine the nature and extent of this relationship.
